statement: For one frozen release-content digest, authoritative operation-ledger release, priority surplus removal, and ordinary ready-lease admission preserve their current real-owner safety invariants with no unresolved in-scope safety case.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Terminal evidence must name the machine-generated release-content digest for the exact candidate and fail closed after any shipped source, package, chart, workflow, or release-metadata change.

Historical open, parked, exhausted, or terminal evidence is provenance only. Closure requires current real-owner red-on-revert proof plus production-path engagement for operation-ledger release, safe surplus removal, and ordinary ready-lease admission.
Any unresolved in-scope topology safety case blocks closure; do not weaken readiness, quorum, count, diversity, startup authority, or destructive-operation fences.
